ruleDefinitions.name: Share And Session Enumeration Using Net.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to enumerate file shares, printer shares and sessions using "net.exe" with the "view" flag.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*view.*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\.*"))
